privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.subtitle: We are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data according to the highest international standards. Learn how your data is collected, used, and protected.

sections.title: Data We Collect
sections.content: We collect only the data necessary to operate the platform: your full name, phone number, National ID (for verification), and your governorate and electoral district. We do not collect browsing data or unnecessary information. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

sections.title: How We Use Your Data
sections.content: Your data is used exclusively to operate the platform: connecting you with your relevant MP, sending notifications about your issues, and verifying your identity as an Egyptian citizen. We do not sell your data to any third party and do not share it except with the MP concerned with your issue and with your consent.

sections.title: Data Protection & Security
sections.content: We apply the highest data security standards: TLS encryption for all communications, encrypted databases at rest, two-factor authentication, and CSRF/XSS protection. We conduct regular security audits and comply with GDPR standards for data protection.

sections.title: Your Rights Over Your Data
sections.content: You have full rights to: access your stored data, correct any inaccurate information, request deletion of your account and all data, and export a copy of your data. To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@haqak.org.

sections.title: Notifications & Communication
sections.content: We only send notifications related to your submitted issues and their updates. We do not send unsolicited marketing messages. You can unsubscribe at any time from your account settings.

sections.title: Data Retention & Deletion
sections.content: We retain your data as long as your account is active. Upon account deletion request, all personal data is deleted within 30 days. We may retain some anonymized data for statistical purposes in accordance with Egyptian law.

sections.title: Privacy Policy Changes
sections.content: Any material changes to this policy will be communicated to you via a clear notice on the platform before taking effect. Your continued use of the platform after notification implies your acceptance of the changes. Last updated: January 2026.

terms_of_service.title: Terms of Service
terms_of_service.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using the Haqak platform. Your use of the platform means you fully agree to these terms.

sections.title: Acceptance & Agreement
sections.content: By using the Haqak platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions and the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to any of these terms, please do not use the platform. These terms govern the relationship between you and the Haqak team.

sections.title: Eligibility
sections.content: The platform is intended for adult Egyptian citizens (18 years and above) and members of the Egyptian Parliament. Information provided during registration must be true, accurate, and complete. We reserve the right to refuse or terminate any account found to have submitted false information.

sections.title: Acceptable Use
sections.content: Users are required to use the platform in a lawful and appropriate manner. Prohibited: submitting malicious or misleading reports, using offensive language or content contrary to public morals, attempting to breach the system or manipulate data, violating any other user's privacy.

sections.title: Confidentiality & Information Protection
sections.content: All submitted issues are treated with strict confidentiality and shared only with the relevant MP. All parties are obligated to maintain the confidentiality of citizens' personal information. We apply strict security standards to protect data from unauthorized access.

sections.title: Account Suspension & Penalties
sections.content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate any account that violates the terms of use. Violations may result in a warning, temporary suspension, or permanent deletion. You may appeal any decision by contacting our support team.

sections.title: Intellectual Property & Content
sections.content: All intellectual property rights of the Haqak platform (logo, design, code) are reserved for the platform team. Content you submit (reports, images, files) remains your property, and you grant us a limited license to use it to operate the service only.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.content: Haqak is an independent civic communication tool and not an official government entity. We do not guarantee the resolution of all submitted issues, as this depends on the response of MPs and concerned authorities. We always strive to improve service quality and communication.

sections.title: Contact & Support
sections.content: For inquiries about the terms or to report a violation, contact us: admin@haqak.org. For technical support: support@haqak.org. For partnerships: team@haqak.org. We commit to responding within 48 business hours.
